name: Granville Station

references.note: Original Big 3 are three parallel 35 m escalators. Published length is not horizontal run.

Three additional Dunsmuir escalators and elevator remain independently usable.
Canmenwalker, CC BY 4.0: enclosed triple escalator shaft, pale panels, red rails, curved acoustic vault.
Wpcpey, CC BY-SA 4.0: tiled lower Dunsmuir faregate hall; only part of the triple bank is visible.
TransLink cutaway and Kenneth Chan photographs: original circulation split; Dunsmuir has a tiled triple shaft and faregates at its bottom, beside the elevator.
Official Dunsmuir shaft photograph: three parallel escalators, tall tiled rectangular walls and glass upper passage.
Canmenwalker, CC BY 4.0: single-track vaulted platform and red wall handrail.
Page 6 primary photographs: bottom-of-bank retail hub and split to platform 1 / platform 2.

authoredInterior.routeSummary: Granville Street → original Bay pair / mall ticket hall → independent 35m vaulted Big3 → platforms. Seymour joins the unpaid upper mall passage. Dunsmuir enters southwest to a lower unpaid hall, turns north/east to its distinct rectangular triple shaft, then reaches bottom faregates and the same three-level elevator.
unverifiedDetails: OSM platform polygons explicitly say location approximate. The original Big3 hidden mall bend/parallel shaft offset is representative, not measured; only its35m sloping length and grouping are published.

Dunsmuir follows the mapped entry direction and corridor/bank turns; the 3m entry descent, shaft rise/run components and hall widths are inferred. The one elevator serves street and both platforms via two graph edges, not two separate lifts.
